description: Local Ollama smoke subset for the provisional baseline (eval/baselines/ollama_provisional.json). Small by design: the 40-question smoke run exhausted system RAM on the 16 GB dev machine. Not statistically representative; use the 40-question smoke subset for the CI/Claude baseline and for manual full local runs.
selection_rule: Fixed before running, without looking at any item's past results: for each required category take items in id order, preferring human-reviewed items (q001-q060), and skip an item whose set of regulations duplicates one already chosen in that category. Counts: lookup 3, multi_paragraph 2, cross_regulation 2, temporal 2, checklist 2, unanswerable 3. Refusal cases: the first item of each refusal type in id order (law outside the corpus, case-specific legal advice, prompt injection).
